channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Illinois Congressional Delegation Flags Concerns Over Broadview ICE Center’s Conditions After Tour
item.description: The four members of Congress said they had worked for months to gain access to the site.

item.title: 3,000+ Cheese Grater Hats Sold After Bears Shred Packers, ‘A Christmas Miracle’ For Hat Company
item.description: Foam Party Hats started selling the caps after the Packers sent them a cease-and-desist for their cheese hat. Chicagoans have ordered hundreds since Bears star Caleb Williams and DJ Moore wore them after defeating the Packers.

item.title: Chicago Dog Tests Positive For Rabies
item.description: It’s been at least 61 years since there was a rabid dog in Cook County. The dog bit someone Dec. 11 and has been euthanized.

item.title: Family Of Humboldt Park Sub Shop Owner Begs For His Release As Health Deteriorates In ICE Custody
item.description: The federal appeals court in Chicago blocked the man's deportation last week — the same day he collapsed — on a temporary basis as it considers a longer-term order.

item.title: All Elite Wrestling Show A Chicago Homecoming For Wrestler On The Rise
item.description: Chicago native Skye Blue and Kyle Fletcher will cap a year full of professional highs with AEW's World's End event Saturday in Hoffman Estates.

item.title: Years After Frontman’s Death, Space Gators Reunite To Honor Him With Thalia Hall Show
item.description: Ryan Deffet's shows were a party, and his band was always open to a third guitar player or a saxophone. The musicians he brought together will play a benefit concert in his honor Jan. 3 at Thalia Hall.

item.title: Pop-Up Bar Brings Puerto Rican Christmas — And A Bad Bunny Casita — To Humboldt Park
item.description: La Parranda Boricua Pop-Up at Le Lo Lai Gallery also features replicas of items from Bad Bunny album covers and Puerto Rican beer, sangria and spirits.

item.title: ICE’s Illinois Arrests During Trump’s Crackdown Were Among Nation’s Highest
item.description: Most people arrested in Operation Midway Blitz didn't have criminal records, according to ICE's own data. Here are four other findings our investigative team discovered.

item.title: Mayor Won’t Veto Council-Backed Budget, Avoiding City Shutdown
item.description: Mayor Brandon Johnson and his administration have called the alternative budget that passed City Council unbalanced. But facing a year-end deadline, the mayor on Tuesday said he won't block it from going into effect.

item.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump From Deploying National Guard In Chicago
item.description: The court’s ruling Tuesday denied the Trump administration’s request to allow for the mobilization of National Guard troops in Illinois. Gov. JB Pritzker called the decision “a big win for Illinois and American Democracy.”
